shortDescription: Module for setup of Scheduler Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: backup_config_ref
options.description: Backup configuration to be executed by this scheduler. It is a reference to an object of type backupconfiguration. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: enabled
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: end_date_time
options.description: Scheduler end date and time. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Frequency at which custom scheduler will run. Allowed values are 0-60. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: frequency_unit
options.description: Unit at which custom scheduler will run. Enum options - SCHEDULER_FREQUENCY_UNIT_MIN, SCHEDULER_FREQUENCY_UNIT_HOUR, SCHEDULER_FREQUENCY_UNIT_DAY, SCHEDULER_FREQUENCY_UNIT_WEEK, SCHEDULER_FREQUENCY_UNIT_MONTH. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of scheduler. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: run_mode
options.description: Scheduler run mode. Enum options - RUN_MODE_PERIODIC, RUN_MODE_AT, RUN_MODE_NOW. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: run_script_ref
options.description: Control script to be executed by this scheduler. It is a reference to an object of type alertscriptconfig. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: scheduler_action
options.description: Define scheduler action. Enum options - SCHEDULER_ACTION_RUN_A_SCRIPT, SCHEDULER_ACTION_BACKUP. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SCHEDULER_ACTION_BACKUP.

options.name: start_date_time
options.description: Scheduler start date and time. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
